ANTIFRAUD::alert_guid
Description
This iRules command returns GUID that is used to identify which users
have been infected with malware before the user logs in.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_guid
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert GUID: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_guid]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
